title: DataOps Agent — Multi-Agent Data Analyst
description: Built a 6-agent system using LangGraph & Gemini 2.5 Flash for automated Text-to-SQL generation and dynamic charting with human-in-the-loop approval gates. Integrated OWASP-aligned prompt injection defenses blocking 94% of adversarial prompts. Deployed on Render with Docker containerization and LangSmith tracing for agent-step observability.

title: PyMind — Enterprise Python RAG Assistant
description: Architected a LangGraph & FastAPI state machine with early-exit routing reducing out-of-topic query latency to ~1ms. Combined ChromaDB vector search and BM25 keyword search across 600K+ Stack Overflow chunks with on-the-fly Tavily web fallback. Cut cloud database transaction latency from 5s to <50ms using connection pooling.

title: Python Interview Assistant
description: An AI-powered Python interview coaching tool built on Hugging Face Spaces. Select difficulty (Easy/Medium/Hard) and topic filters (OOP, Decorators, AsyncIO, FastAPI etc.), then get detailed answers with code examples to sharpen your Python interview skills.

title: SyncForge IDE — Real-time Collaborative Code Editor
description: A full-stack, real-time collaborative IDE designed for remote pair programming, technical interviews, and educational purposes. Multiple users can edit code simultaneously with live cursors, code execution, and room-based sessions.

title: CodeCrew — P2P Code Sharing & Video Chat
description: A collaborative peer-to-peer code sharing and video chat platform. Easily share code, chat in real-time, and collaborate with peers in a modern, minimal UI. Built for remote teams and pair programming sessions.

title: YourNotebook — Full-Stack Notes App
description: A full-stack MERN notes manager with JWT authentication. Users can create, update, delete, and organize notes securely. Features a React frontend with a Node.js/Express backend and MongoDB database with REST API.

title: HeartGuard — Heart Disease Prediction ML
description: A machine learning web application that predicts heart disease risk using patient health parameters. Trained on clinical datasets with scikit-learn classifiers; exposed via a Python Flask REST API with a responsive React frontend.

title: Code Together — Real-time Code Editor
description: Real-time collaborative code editor built with Node.js and Socket.io. Users can join rooms with a shared code editor and collaborate live. Simple, lightweight and beginner-friendly implementation of real-time sync.

title: Daily News App
description: A React-powered news aggregator that fetches real-time headlines across categories — Business, Entertainment, Sports, Science, and Technology — using the NewsAPI. Features infinite scroll, category filtering, and a clean card-based layout.

title: Textpulator — Text Manipulation Utility
description: A text manipulation web utility app with real-time text analysis. Features include UPPERCASE/lowercase conversion, word/character/sentence count, extra space removal, copy-to-clipboard, and dark mode. Built with React.js.
